verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair axis for an open-finance API platform, but the evidence pack documents no export, bulk-download or offboarding capability. Paginated List endpoints (up to 1000 results per page, filterable by link) are developer building blocks for pulling data through the API, not a documented 'export all my data in open formats and leave' feature. The evidence also says nothing about export formats, account deletion or migration.
